name: zerotier
title: ZeroTier
description: Joins the printer to a ZeroTier mesh network, so you can reach Fluidd/Mainsail, the camera, and SSH from anywhere without opening a port on your router. Bring your own account: create a free network at my.zerotier.com, then paste its 16-hex-digit network id below. The printer authorizes itself the way any ZeroTier device does; approve it in ZeroTier Central like you would a laptop or phone. Bespok3d hosts no coordination service and never sees your network id or traffic. Runs zerotier-one as a managed service on top of the tun-module base (a real /dev/net/tun the ZeroTier virtual network interface needs).
tagline: Reach your printer from anywhere over a ZeroTier mesh network.

config.label: ZeroTier network id
config.hint: 16 hex digits, from your ZeroTier Central account (my.zerotier.com). Bring your own network; Bespok3d hosts nothing. After install, approve the printer's device in ZeroTier Central.
